Case reference: 2014002549.CaseDesc: Wladyslaw Klisko was last seen on September 11, 1983 in Montreal, Quebec. Wladyslaw left his house in the morning and boarded a bus to go to church but he was never seen at the church.

Case reference: 2014001761.CaseDesc: Henrietta Mille is originally from Nain, Newfoundland and had been living in St. John’s, Newfoundland for quite some time before her disappearance. Henrietta was known to frequent the clubs in the St. John’s downtown area. Her keys, purse and other belongings were found at the Key Club.

Case reference: 2010002599.CaseDesc: On the morning of Monday, July 19, 2010, Curtis Barry left his residence on Britannia Avenue in Bradford, to walk his two dogs. He was reported missing when his wife returned home in the late afternoon and discovered he was not home. The dogs were located later the same day wandering the streets approximately 1 km from his residence. Curtis has not been seen since and the dog leash has not been located.

Tattoo: Left Forearm, a ship and names Lauren, John and Cliff on boat
Torso (Back), 3 roses with names of Michelle, Kietan and Kayla

Case reference: 2006006399.CaseDesc: Gerald Joseph Bouchard was last seen on the morning of June 4, 1998, in the Town of Moosonee, Ontario. Moosonee is a remote Northern Ontario community situated on the coast of James Bay. There are no roads to Moosonee and access is by rail or aircraft. It is believed that he may have left Moosonee by jumping on a rail boxcar.

Case reference: 2014001028.CaseDesc: The body of this middle aged man was found in the Fraser River near Quesnel, British Columbia on May 20, 1968. He was well dressed and had custom orthotic supports in his shoes. He would have been born around 1920, had grey hair and likely had full dentures.

Other: Case, Leather case with nail clippers
Metal, Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Pen Knife, Pen Knife
Leather, Black, Small key case with 15 keys
Shoes: Leather, Black, Pointed dress shoe with Dr.Scholl's arch support insole
Wallet: Brown, Light brown leather wallet with dark brown stitching

Case reference: 2014005536.CaseDesc: In the afternoon of March 25, 1996, Renée Simard was seen for the last time as she left her family home in Matane, Quebec. Renée had indicated that she was going for a walk, and at approximately 2:30 p.m. she was seen near the wharf along the Matane River at the mouth of the St. Lawrence River.

Case reference: 2014004359.CaseDesc: On July 20, 2003, Stephane Gallant was last seen at the Shoreline Hotel in Thunder Bay, Ontario.  Stephane speaks French and English with a French accent.  Stephane worked in the logging industry as a woodcutter. On July 23, 2003, his vehicle, a 1984 GMC S10 blue pickup with a black topper, was located at the Trowbridge Falls campsite on Copenhagen Road in Thunder Bay, Ontario.

Case reference: 2015011654.CaseDesc: On December 3, 1994, a baby was found in the Rivière des Prairies between the island of Montréal and the Visitation park Island in the Ahuntsic neighborhood. The body was naked and had a plastic bag wrapped around the wrist. According to experts the body would have been in the water since the fall.

Case reference: 2021017400.CaseDesc: On April 24, 2021, at approximately 12:15 a.m., Saniyya Dennis was seen for the last time on the pedestrian bridge leading to Goat Island in Niagara Falls, New York. Saniyya sent a last text message at 1:23 a.m., from the Goat Island and Luna Island area.

Hat: Black, Knit, White lettering on the brim
Shoes: Black, White, Black and white check "VANS" shoes
Sweater: Black, Hoodie, White lettering on the left side of chest and across the back

Case reference: 2016061228.CaseDesc: On June 14, 1970, a male was found floating in Lake Ontario near the mouth of the Humber River. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 201lbs and his length was measured at 5'10", however, these measurements may not represent his actual living weight and height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. His appendix was present. He is thought to have been in the water for a few days to several days.

Shoes: Black, only the left shoe has laces

Case reference: 2014001366.CaseDesc: On April 19, 1995, Paul-Henri Hardy was seen for the last time in the St-Romuald sector of Lévis, Quebec. Paul-Henry was 28 years old at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2014006252.CaseDesc: On September 12, 2013, Meagan Rose Pilon was seen for the last time at her family home in Sudbury, Ontario. At the time of her disappearance, Meagan was living in the New Sudbury area. Police have not been able to rule out foul play in her disappearance.

Mark: Left Chest, Red birthmark on inner left breast

Case reference: 2014005155.CaseDesc: Harold Murray Harvey was seen for the last time by a neighbour in front of his residence in Pincourt, Quebec on September 14, 2008. Harold was reported missing by a family member on September 19, 2008. At the time of his disappearance Harold was taking medication, which he left behind. Harold had a history of leaving his home in the past but always returned after a couple of days.

Case reference: 2014004478.CaseDesc: On May 1, 2004, Norman Halkett was last seen in Prince Albert, Saskatchewan.

Fractured/Broken Bones: Right Elbow, Transverse fracture across base of olecranon

Case reference: 2006011299.CaseDesc: Henry Atlookan left Whiteclay Lake in a canoe to travel 55 km to Armstrong, Ontario. He may have been seen on June 25, 1968 making a purchase at a local store in the Town of Armstrong. He has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2024001775.CaseDesc: Brady Storey was reported missing to police by his mother on January 11, 2024 from Fredericton, New Brunswick. Brady was last seen with Leslie Boyd, who was also reported missing around the same time. Last contact with the couple was on November 7, 2023. Brady was involved in high-risk lifestyle at the time of his disappearance.

Sweater: Cotton, White, Text "Playboy" in black lettering
Tattoo: Left Chest, Text, "Better to die standing than to live on your knees"

Case reference: 2014005742.CaseDesc: Philip Mark Oslizlok was reported missing by his family in early 2010. He was last seen on September 2, 2009 when he went to the Vancouver Police Department to receive an employment record clearance. Mr. Oslizlok last contacted his family via email on November 20, 2009 to inform them that he had gotten a job on a cruise line and would not be returning home for Christmas. There are no records of employment for Philip at any of the cruise lines. He has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2022052659.CaseDesc: On October 16, 2022, Bradley Kiefer was seen for the last time by his family in Medicine Hat, Alberta. At the time of his disappearance, all of Bradley’s personal belongings, and vehicle were left at his residence.

Case reference: 2014004546.CaseDesc: On November 10, 2004, Roy Lewis was last seen hitchhiking in Sackville, New Brunswick.

Case reference: 2014005482.CaseDesc: Shaun Chris MacDonald-McLaughlin was reported missing on March 27, 2010 by his step-father. Shaun was last seen by his roommate on March 12, 2010, in Vancouver, British Columbia when he packed his belongings and stated he was going home. Shaun was known to have substance abuse problems and was diagnosed as a paranoid-schizophrenic.

Case reference: 2013000044.CaseDesc: Carole Roy, who also went by several aliases, was last seen in 1996 near Carleton Place, Ontario. Carole has lived in Carleton Place, Ottawa, and various places in Québec. She was reported missing by her family.

Case reference: 2014005633.CaseDesc: On July 7, 2011, Dillon McMaster had been swimming in the Bow River in Alberta with a group of friends. Dillon was caught in a current, pulled under and was not seen again. Multiple efforts to locate Dillon were negative and he is presumed to have drowned.

Case reference: 2014004308.CaseDesc: Joseph Laboucan was last seen in Peace River, Alberta, on or around August 10, 1998. He lived on the streets in Peace River and Little Buffalo, Alberta. He made occasional trips around the area as far as Edmonton.

Case reference: 2014003086.CaseDesc: On January 30, 1997, Maurizio Di Caprio was last seen in Montreal, Quebec. Maurizio left for Chicoutimi, Quebec or Toronto, Ontario to bring back a vehicle to Montreal.

Case reference: 2012020041.CaseDesc: Carolyn Pruyser was last seen at a Mohawk service station in Peace River, Alberta, shortly after midnight on May 17, 1984.  Carolyn's vehicle was found abandoned a short distance from her parents' home, with the keys and her purse still inside.

Blouse: Yellow, Orange, Short Sleeve "V" Neck Blouse

Case reference: 2021050990.CaseDesc: On November 4, 2021, Antony Anuj was last heard from via text message. The origin tower signals of the texts were traced to the Niagara Falls, Ontario area.

Case reference: 2012020071.CaseDesc: Richard Tssessaze's last known place of residence was Brandon, Manitoba.  He had previously lived in Thompson and Lac Brochet.  He was last seen in the area around the St. Regis Hotel on Smith Street in downtown Winnipeg in late June 2009.  Richard has not been seen or heard from since that time, and his whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2014002711.CaseDesc: Sharel Haresym was reported missing on September 6, 1984, and was last seen on September 4, 1984. His vehicle was located parked on the entrance road to the Twin Lakes campground near Winfield, Alberta. The vehicle was out of fuel and also had a dead battery. Sharel's clothing was found approximately 90 metres east of his vehicle. His garments were meticulously arranged, with his Bible positioned nearby.

Case reference: 2014005411.CaseDesc: On August 27, 1992, around 4:00 p.m., Bernard Robitaille left the St. Charles Boromée hospital after refusing treatment. Bernard left on foot and has never been seen since. At the time of his disappearance he was carrying a Metro grocery plastic bag containing his personal belongings. Bernard's name and address were written on the bag.

Scar: Forehead, top of the right eye

Case reference: 2016061381.CaseDesc: On April 25, 1970 a Caucasian male was found in the ravine just north of Beechwood Ave. The ravine was located 300 yards south of the Leaside Bridge and approximately 100 yards east of the Don River.

Other: Rifle - Winchester Model 94 30-30 calibre, with a black and white rifle case

Case reference: 2014004850.CaseDesc: On November 26, 2006, Mario Julien was seen for the last time when he left his home in Lévis, Quebec aboard a taxi. The taxi transported him just to the roundabout in the Québec Bridge, in Quebec City, Quebec.

Case reference: 2025048528.CaseDesc: Paul Lacasse was last seen on August 9, 2025. There has been no communication or sighting of Paul since his disappearance and he has not collected his government assistance cheques since that date.

Case reference: 2014001528.CaseDesc: On June 17, 1983, Herbert Keam spent the night at a friend's house in Poplar River, Manitoba. He asked his friend to accompany him to Norway House. His friend declined, but they went to Herbert's sister's house together, then went their separate ways. His sister saw him that morning. He changed his clothes and left without saying where he was going, and was reported missing on June 20th. The police later determined that he had attempted to walk 112 km to Norway House through the bush, but had set off in the wrong direction. A ground search involving a police dog found various items of clothing belonging to Herbert, but he has not yet been found and his whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2014003937.CaseDesc: On February 14, 1990, Reynald Fortin was seen for the last time in the Verdun district of Montreal, Quebec. He was known to be despondent and to consume alcohol. Reynald left his apartment without his identification or money.

Case reference: 2019049183.CaseDesc: On March 4, 2017, an unidentified woman was found in a state of acute confusion on East Cordova Street in Vancouver, British Columbia. She was taken to hospital, but died due to advanced and untreated breast cancer. She gave the name of Elizabeth MacKay to health services, but had no identification with her and her name could not be confirmed.

Case reference: 2021023948.CaseDesc: On May 6, 2021, David Anthony Gale was seen for the last time at the Independent Grocer in Athabasca, Alberta. David has not been seen or heard from since and police are seeking the public's assistance for any information regarding his disappearance.

Case reference: 2006007299.CaseDesc: On November 1, 1985, Byron Simmons and Julie Ann Schneider were observed fishing from a boat in Lake Huron. They were near the Nuclear Power Generation Station, near Inverhuron, Ontario, in the outflow from the nuclear plant. The couple failed to return to their cottage and are presumed drowned.  Their boat was recovered the following spring washed up on shore to the north, near Oliphant, Ontario.

Hair: Grey, White, Other, Short, Afro style

Case reference: 2024055153.CaseDesc: Edmund Zielinski last spoke to his family on July 29 2024 and is believed to be in the area of Genesse County, NY, USA. Edmund is known to have suffered from paranoia and it is possible that he may have made his way to the gorge area of Niagara Falls.

Scar: Neck, On the neck from spinal surgery

Case reference: 2014004096.CaseDesc: On June 19, 1990, at approximately 4:00pm, Elizabeth Bain was seen for the last time leaving her residence in Toronto, Ontario. Elizabeth was seen leaving in her 1981 Toyota Tercel and was heading to the Scarborough Campus of the University of Toronto. On June 22, her vehicle was found abandoned near the University’s campus.

Case reference: 2006007499.CaseDesc: David Goetz and Lucas Zenger were last seen on August 23, 1992, in the Owen Sound area. They went for a canoe ride.  They travelled down the shoreline along Kepple Township, towards Big Bay. The canoe was located approximately 1.5 miles off Cape Commodore.

Case reference: 2014004742.CaseDesc: On January 9, 2006, Michael James Bosma left on foot from a care home located on Bernard Avenue in Kelowna, BC and failed to return.  Mr. Bosma had been diagnosed with schizophrenia and required essential medication.  ATM activity was recorded on his account during the night and early morning hours following his departure then all traces of him ceased.

Case reference: 1996006630.CaseDesc: Adam, Mitchell and Trevor O'Brien have been reported missing since November 9, 1996 from Mount Pearl, Newfoundland & Labrador. The three brothers may be in the company of their father.

Case reference: 2025067893.CaseDesc: The skeletonised remains of this young adult male were discovered in a ravine in Burnaby, British Columbia, on October 15, 2025. It is likely that he was missing for up to 18 months prior to being found, and he had sustained an injury to his right foot, which had become infected.

Case reference: 2013000075.CaseDesc: On December 15, 1988, Jean Berthiaume was seen for the last time in the Mount Royal area of Montreal, Quebec. Jean's vehicle was located at the Dorval Airport in Montreal. No one has seen or heard from him since.

Scar: Right Upper Arm, "U" shaped above the elbow

Case reference: 2014002728.CaseDesc: On May 25, 1996, at approximately 2:00 p.m., Gary Landry was last seen as he left his residence in Thunder Bay, Ontario, on his dark blue 12 speed Supercycle Mountain bike with black plastic fenders. Gary was prone to having seizures and frequented the north side of Thunder Bay on his bicycle.

Case reference: 2002005560.CaseDesc: On July 2, 1975, at approximately 8:30 p.m., Michelle Wedge returned to her residence, but left shortly afterwards. Her bicycle was later located at the intersection of John and Dominion Street, which was not far from her residence in Moncton, New Brunswick.

Shorts: Synthetic, Blue, navy blue, stretchy polyester

Case reference: 2024040098.CaseDesc: Christian Waskahat was last seen on July 19, 2024, in Edmonton, Alberta. At the time of his disappearance, he was believed to be in the Whyte Avenue area of Edmonton. Christian led a high-risk lifestyle prior to his disappearance.

Upper Back, Text "DEVIL WANTS MY SOUL"
Right Upper Arm, Illustrated proverb "Hear no evil - speak no evil", pistol, faces and skull
Right Side Of Neck, Illustrated smoke or clouds
Left Cheek, Unknown text or word
Left Hand, Cross on middle finger and letter "M"

Case reference: 2023012025.CaseDesc: On March 6th, 2023, Kimberly Jackson was last seen shortly after 12:00 pm in the area of Prospect Point, American Falls, in Niagara Falls, New York. At the time of her disappearance Kimberly was despondent.

Coat: Maroon, Black, Winter, Black fur around the hood.
Tattoo: Right Upper Arm, Samurai skull with a knife

Case reference: 2014003848.CaseDesc: On November 5, 1964, the Grand Rapids RCMP were advised that Harvey Hudson was two weeks overdue in returning from a trip to Cedar Lake from Grand Rapids, Manitoba. It was established that Harvey left The Pas on October 20th and arrived at the Cedar Lake Post.  When he reached Cedar Lake, he was told to wait for a boat from Easterville which was expected shortly. A witness said he walked to Easterville but turned back. He then took a canoe and set off for Easterville, using a piece of board as a paddle. It is believed that Harvey had little or no food, rifle or other camping supplies. Numerous land, air and water patrols were made with negative results.

Case reference: 2006022099.CaseDesc: Duane Wicklund and Edward Kotula were last seen on October 7, 1967, in a loaded boat on Sturgeon Lake. They were vacationing in the area and heading to Margaret Resort on Harris Bay. Neither has been seen since and both are presumed to have drowned.

Scar: Nose, from nose to upper lip

Case reference: 2014001288.CaseDesc: On November 9th, 1993, Violet Zarb was observed leaving her residence in Port Colborne, Ontario, shortly after 8:30 AM. Her vehicle was located on Clifton Hill, Niagara Falls, Ontario the next day.  Violet's whereabouts remain unknown to this date. At the time of her disappearance, Violet was possibly wearing a black leather jacket and blue jeans.

Jewelry: Other, Ring, Maltese worn on pinky finger

Case reference: 2014002831.CaseDesc: On December 26, 1980, Zulfiqar Charania was seen for the last time in Montreal, Quebec. During the time of his disappearance, Zulfiqar lived in Ottawa but was at his sister’s home in Montreal to spend the holidays. When Zulfiqar left Montreal he did so without his suitcase, which was filled with his personal belongings. Zulfiqar had indicated that he intended on travelling to New York in the United States to visit another family member.

Case reference: 2012020143.CaseDesc: On October 23, 1996, Lucie Bouchard was last seen driving her vehicle, a 1994 purple Honda Civic in Montreal, Quebec. Lucie dropped off her sister near the intersection of Cremazie East Boulevard and Saint-Michel Boulevard around 9:45 p.m. After that, Lucie was expected to return home to Brossard, Quebec on Montreal's south shore, but she never arrived. Lucie suffers from epilepsy and requires medication.

Case reference: 2022065086.CaseDesc: Marcos Sosa Mercado was last seen on November 18, 2022 in Niagara Falls, Ontario. At that time Marcos was feeling despondent.

Case reference: 2017073542.CaseDesc: On November 4, 2016, an unidentified man was discovered in Lake Ontario in St. Catharines, Ontario. Biogeographic ancestry testing predicts he was of East Asian Ancestry.

Case reference: 2019033665.CaseDesc: On July 18, 1988, the remains of a male were found in a field on the side of road 132 in Tracy, Québec. A camp was found near the remains.

Case reference: 2010001999.CaseDesc: Jeffrey Dekleyn was last seen on December 3, 1992, at 1:35 p.m., when he was recorded on a Hamilton RBC bank surveillance camera withdrawing money from an ATM. The family have not had any contact with him since that time and have described Jeffrey as being despondent.

Hat: Blue, Baseball cap with "Labatt Blue" logo
Jacket: Brown, Dempster's logo on the left chest
Scar: Torso (Front), Front-to-Back scar on abdomen from surgery to remove kidney.

Case reference: 2012020045.CaseDesc: The Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) is seeking the public's assistance in locating Shirley Ann Waquan. Shirley was last seen on July 1, 2007 in Fort McMurray, Alberta.

Case reference: 2016000962.CaseDesc: On January 5, 2016, Felix Claveau was last seen when he jumped off the Viau Bridge into the Rivière-des-Prairies in Laval, Quebec. Felix hasn’t been seen since.

Case reference: 2014005172.CaseDesc: Debra Marlow was last seen in Kingston Ontario on November 3rd, 2008, where she had a mental health assessment at Kingston General Hospital. She was despondent at that time, and has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014030665.CaseDesc: On January 19, 1978, the partial remains of a female believed to be aged between 55-70 years of age, were found in the waters of the Salish Sea, southwest of Victoria, British Columbia. She had moderate arthritis and significant healed injuries to her left ankle and foot. It is believed she was deceased several months or even years before her remains were recovered

Case reference: 2007003599.CaseDesc: On October 2, 2000 Marilyn Zaitzeff left her cottage located on Lambert Island, Lake Superior. She was operating a personal watercraft at the time. The watercraft was located overturned several hundred metres away from the cottage. Marilyn has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2008005899.CaseDesc: On December 30, 1965, George Angeconeb left Red Lake on foot with plans to walk to Trout Lake.  He left during a severe snowstorm carrying a record player.  He was last seen at MacDowell Lake, First Nation Territory, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014006281.CaseDesc: Henri-Joel Anvire's original nationality is from the Ivory Coast, and he relocated to Ottawa, Ontario at the age of 11.  He has resided in Ottawa until his disappearance in 2009.  In October 2009, Henri-Joel informed his employer that he was going to Montreal, Quebec, and has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2014004817.CaseDesc: On September 10, 2006, Timothy Lang departed his residence in Chilliwack, British Columbia in his vehicle, a grey Chevrolet Metro. Timothy left behind all his personal belongings, wallet, and passport. On September 11, 2006, his vehicle was located in the parking lot of the Othello Tunnels in the Coquihalla Canyon Provincial Park, located in Hope, British Columbia.

Case reference: 2014005328.CaseDesc: In October 1986, Frances Neilson was observed by family leaving her residence in Edmonton, Alberta in the family vehicle. A few days later the vehicle was recovered but Frances has not been heard from since.

Case reference: 2014005006.CaseDesc: On September 10, 2007, Sun Jin, her husband Joon Han, and their daughter Il Han were seen for the last time at a school in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014004550.CaseDesc: On November 18, 2004, David Creaser was seen for the last time in Edmonton, Alberta.

Tattoo: Shoulders, One side features a tigre, and the other, a dragon

Case reference: 2014005770.CaseDesc: On August 29, 1979, Thomas Lidguerre and Lawrence Sanger headed out from Fond du Lac to Uranium City on Lake Athabaska, Saskatchewan. The boat was located two days later, swamped near the Narrows and Popular Point. A search was conducted and lasted for over one month without any success in locating Thomas and Lawrence.

Case reference: 2006021099.CaseDesc: Roy Britten was last seen in a 14-foot aluminum boat in the Birch Beach area heading toward the northeast part of Caribou Island, Lake Superior, Ontario.  He is presumed drowned.

Jacket: Blue, Thunder Bay Police Force Association

Case reference: 2014003554.CaseDesc: On May 30, 1986, Edward Ludwig was seen for the last time as he left his work site at the Bow Valley Provincial Park in Canmore, Alberta. At this time, Edward was on his way to go boating on Lake Minnewanka in Banff National Park in Alberta. His boat was found empty floating on the lake. During the time of his disappearance, Edward was despondent.

Case reference: 2005152590.CaseDesc: Helen went for a walk and did not return. At the time of her disappearance, Helen had only been in Prince George for a few weeks.

Case reference: 2010003699.CaseDesc: On the evening of Friday, May 31 1974, seven-year-old Cheryl Hanson left her home on Bloomington Road in Aurora, Ontario, for a 10-minute walk to her cousin's house, which was also located on Bloomington Road. Unfortunately, Cheryl never arrived and there has been no trace of her or her belongings.

Case reference: 2005001599.CaseDesc: Shawn Jones and Leslie Jones were last seen together between October 26- 28, 1993, at the Tim Hortons in Owen Sound, Ontario.  Shawn was seen on Berford Street in front of the Pacific Hotel and Leslie was seen on 9th East Street in front of the Tim Hortons.

Case reference: 1996000260.CaseDesc: On March 17, 1995, Jay Boyle, Michael Cummings, Daniel Higgins, Jamie Lefebvre, Robert Rumbolt, and Chad Smith were seen for the last time walking towards the East Shore Marina in Pickering, Ontario. Case reference: 2008015499.CaseDesc: Sheryl Sheppard was last seen on January 2 1998, on Lundy's Lane in Niagara Falls, Ontario. An extensive investigation by the Hamilton Police Service was conducted but Sheryl has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014002598.CaseDesc: Tina Fang Chen arrived in Canada from China in May 2000 and stayed in Mississauga Ontario for approximately 3 weeks, until her disappearance on June 9, 2000.  It is believed that she had the intention to enter the USA and was possibly headed for New York State.

Case reference: 2015011636.CaseDesc: On June 20, 1998, a fisherman saw the body of a man floating in the St. Lawrence River in front of L'Île aux Vaches, Quebec.

Socks: White, Grey, white top and grey on bottom

Case reference: 2006013599.CaseDesc: Donald Taylor has been missing from South Porcupine, Ontario since August 24, 1989 at 7:00 in the morning and has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2025024697.CaseDesc: On May 15, 2025, the Canadian Coast Guard Search and Rescue team found a sailboat belonging to Amber Nitchman washed up on the shore near 5362 Bayshore Road in Nanaimo, British Columbia. Case reference: 2014001666.CaseDesc: On October 1, 1995, Shaun McEleney was last seen in Edmonton, Alberta. Shawn was known to attend the racing tracks in Edmonton and Calgary.

Case reference: 2014006380.CaseDesc: Dean Kelly Morrison was last seen October 23, 2013, after being dismissed from his job. His vehicle was left abandoned on a ranch.

Case reference: 2014004932.CaseDesc: Mathieu Daneau's disappearance occurred on April 3, 2007 in the region of St-Hyacinthe, Quebec. Mathieu  was admitted for treatment at the L'Envolée Center. Mathieu left the center and has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2025022648.CaseDesc: Joseph William H. Harvey (also known as "Bill Harvey") was reported missing by his family on February 26, 2025. The investigation revealed that on February 3, 2024, Joseph flew from Vancouver International Airport to Sacramento, California, USA. Joseph and his vehicle were last seen on February 19, 2024, waiting for roadside assistance. He was parked facing southbound on Interstate 15 at milepost 20, a 28-mile stretch of highway passing through Arizona between St. George, Utah, and Mesquite, Nevada. He was reportedly en route to Death Valley, California.

Case reference: 2014002843.CaseDesc: A party of 6 men departed Churchill, Manitoba, on a fishing trip traveling in three canoes. On June 20, 1967, two of the three canoes became stranded on mud flats at a point where the Hayes and Nelson Rivers empty into the Hudson Bay. The men made camp for the night and then the following day Kurt Hild, Ronald Davidson and James Cochrane all attempted to retrieve the stranded canoes. On return to the camp the men were confronted with high winds and freezing rain which forced them out of sight. None of the remains of the men have been recovered. Foul play is not suspected in the matter.

Case reference: 2014003978.CaseDesc: Ernest Robert Pfaff left home at approximately 8pm on December 31, 1973 to purchase a loaf of bread. He was driving a 1972 Ford Maverick, light blue in colour, with red pin stripes on the sides.

Coat: Grey, Three quarter length pile coat

Case reference: 2014004934.CaseDesc: On February 28, 1976, at approximately 5:30 pm, Jean Cardinale was seen for the last time at the Bayview Village Plaza in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014004318.CaseDesc: On the morning of April 13, 2001, Céline Goyette was dropped off at her husband Richard Gleeson's residence, located on Forestwood Street in Rosemère, Quebec. Since that time, she has not been seen and has not given any more news to her relatives. Moreover, her spouse Richard Gleeson has also disappeared since that time.

Case reference: 2014004654.CaseDesc: Richard Brokke was last seen at approximately 8:10 a.m. on July 15, 2005 leaving the 7-11 Store on St. Mary's Road in Winnipeg, Manitoba. His vehicle was located on July 19, 2005 near St. Jean Baptiste, Manitoba. Richard's whereabouts remain unknown.

Shirt: Denim, White, Green, Golf shirt with green stripes on front

Case reference: 2014002914.CaseDesc: Edward Allan Street was last seen at his rooming house on Columbia St in Kamloops, BC. Case reference: 2021015656.CaseDesc: On October 22, 2017, Ann Victor-Lazarus was seen for the last time as she left her home to go to church. Ann’s vehicle was found in a parking lot near the “Parking Authority Water Intakes” on the Niagara River Parkway in Niagara Falls, New York State. Her personal belongings, as well as a note, were found in her vehicle. Ann was captured on video surveillance near the railing of the waterway.

Case reference: 2014004602.CaseDesc: Denis Gelinas left his home in Notre-Dame-du-Mont-Carmel, Quebec on the morning of December 31, 1993 and was never seen again.

Case reference: 2014004400.CaseDesc: Deoclides Santos was last seen on November 27, 2003, in Kitchener, Ontario, by his son.

Case reference: 2012020165.CaseDesc: The remains of this male were found in a forested area immediately north of the Port Coquitlam cemetery.
